Now most DRM-removal tools will no longer work.

articles.title: I spent 3 days with the Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro — and there’s only one I would buy
articles.summary: It’s not the best time to buy a smartphone right now. The RAM crisis has driven up prices and widened the gap between mid-range phones and flagships. It’s harder than ever for manufacturers to offer phones that feel like good value without hiking prices. And while market pundits may argue that buying a premium flagship makes more sense than settling for a watered-down mid-ranger, the Pixel 11 makes a surprisingly strong case for spending less. The base Pixel 11 starts at $899 — $100 more than the Pixel 10 — but still $200 less than the Pixel 11 Pro. And the more time I spend with it, the more I realize that most of what I actually want from a Pixel is already here.

articles.title: Does the Pixel 11 series support DSDA? Here’s what we found
articles.summary: TL;DR The Pixel 11 series has officially abandoned Samsung modems in favor of a new MediaTek platform. While Reddit forums claim the new hardware brings true Dual-SIM Dual-Active (DSDA) support, Google has now confirmed the phones don’t support the feature, validating our hardware tests. The Pixel 11 series operates strictly in Dual-SIM Dual Standby (DSDS) mode, proving Google has restricted simultaneous data and voice paths at the software or hardware level. Following weeks of heavy speculation on tech forums like Reddit, Google has finally stepped in to deliver the official verdict on Dual-Sim Dual-Active (DSDA) support for the Pixel 11 series.

articles.title: “The opening stages of OpenAI’s unraveling”: OpenAI slows model training — not everyone is buying the explanation
articles.summary: Something of a trend has emerged this year, with the major AI labs going all-out to tell the world how powerfully unsafe their models are. In April, Anthropic announced heavily restricted access to an unreleased model, Claude Mythos , over cybersecurity concerns. In June, the US government went further, issuing a national security directive that forced Anthropic to disable Mythos and its sibling Fable 5 model for every customer — a move criticized by the security community, and which the government reversed a few weeks later . OpenAI, for its part, has been sounding similar alarms about its own unreleased models. In early August, the company said that its upcoming Astra model may have crossed into “critical” territory for cybersecurity risk under its internal safety frame

articles.summary: A BIOS update for the Framework Laptop 13 with AMD Ryzen 7040-series processors is bricking the systems, multiple users have reported online. articles.title: Flight attendants freaked out that Google is buying tons of Spirit employee data
articles.summary: Last Friday, Google won an auction to acquire a huge amount of Spirit Airlines data. The data doesn’t include personal information or customer data, but instead nearly covers the airline's entire employment and workplace record. To ensure that no individual can be identified in the dataset, Google agreed to use a court-appointed ombudsman to oversee a process to strip any personally identifying information (PII) from the data before it’s transferred to Google. Under the deal, Google agreed to maintain the data in this de-identified form and to never intentionally re-identify the data. And if Google sells access to the data, third parties would supposedly be bound by the same terms. Read full article Comments

articles.summary: Sgr A* is the name we've given to the supermassive black hole that sits at the center of the Milky Way. In essence, those stars acted as instruments that let us peer into an environment we couldn't study any other way.
